The algorithm

From messy PDF to ranked shortlist in four moves.

No black boxes. Every score can be broken down to which skills matched, which didn't, and how much each was weighted.

01
Upload

Drop a PDF or DOCX. We pull the text with pdf-parse / mammoth — no manual form filling.

02
Parse

An LLM extracts skills, experience and education into validated JSON, stored in Postgres.

03
Vectorize

Both job requirements and candidate profiles become weighted skill vectors — must-haves outweigh nice-to-haves.

04
Rank

Cosine similarity produces a % fit score. Applicants get sorted, candidates get personal recs.
